proof_body:
by
  intro G _ _ _ f g ψ
  rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum]
  simp only [Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun y _ => ?_)
  rw [← Equiv.sum_comp (Equiv.addLeft y) (fun x => f y * g (x - y) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (ψ x))]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun z _ => ?_)
  simp only [Equiv.coe_addLeft, add_sub_cancel_left, AddChar.map_add_eq_mul, map_mul]
  ring
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G] [DecidableEq G] (f g : G → ℂ) (ψ : AddChar G ℂ), ∑ x, (∑ y, f y * g (x - y)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (ψ x) = (∑ y, f y * (starRingEnd ℂ) (ψ y)) * ∑ z, g z * (starRingEnd ℂ) (ψ z)
